src/input/input_mod_axes.cpp.semantic_justification: All100lines read, including word/absolute/clipped/low16/Direction/direction, decoder and both public algorithms. Native coefficient decoding is a20-byte value conversion, not executable parsing. Strict both-axes early deadzone check precedes clipped-32768 input; Y-square precedes X-square, sum narrows before double sqrt then narrows to single. UCOMISD status is retained. COMISS/CMOVBE-style cap differs from MINSS; controller128 scaling converts to low16 before signed clamp127, nonradial suppresses each sub-deadzone component. Keyboard127 direction is separate from capped magnitude; left Y/magnitude/X then right X/magnitude/Y stores are intentional. Singular deadzone32767 and low16 indefinite behavior must survive. c/d/l/r/lo/ro and compressed compound statements obscure these semantically distinct policies; header addresses/store-site comments are not canonical FUNCTION/DATA annotations. Rewrite the calculation names/control presentation under the same judge; do not relocate all axis behavior to reference or replace the selected SSE semantics with host sqrt.

resolved_owners.resolution: InputModRawAxes and coefficient values are caller-owned; direction and conversion temporaries are invocation-local. InputModAxesOutput optionals track not-yet-completed component stores before an arithmetic exception, not missing guest bytes or a missing game device. Caller reuse preserves prior fields unless a source store is reached. The decoder rejects a missing/wrong-sized20-byte caller buffer and never opens an EXE/DLL. That boundary nullopt is decoding failure, not fixture availability threaded through the axis algorithm.

Keyboard priority applies independently to each nonzero stick/trigger.
